[element-def-list]
=== `<def-list>` Definition List

List in which each item consists of two parts: 1] a word, phrase, term, graphic, chemical structure, or equation, that is paired with 2] one or more descriptions, discussions, explanations, or definitions of it.

#### Usage/Remarks
The definition <<element-def,`<def>`>> part of an item in a two-part (definition) list need not be a “definition” in the strict dictionary sense of that word. Such a definition could be a discussion, explanation, expansion, or something that tells the reader about the <<element-term,`<term>`>>. When a <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>> is within a <<element-glossary,`<glossary>`>> element, the definitions are assumed to be real definitions.

#### Related Elements

A <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>> may take a <<element-label,`<label>`>> that provides it with a number, followed by an optional <<element-title,`<title>`>> naming the entire list, followed by optional headings for terms and their definitions. <<element-term-head,`<term-head>`>> contains the heading over the first (term) column, and <<element-def-head,`<def-head>`>> contains the heading for the second (definition) column; neither serves as a container element for terms or definitions. Individual <<element-term,`<term>`>>s and their <<element-def,`<def>`>>s are paired in <<element-def-item,`<def-item>`>>s. Definition lists are recursive, so following all the terms and definitions, there may be one or more embedded <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>> elements.

#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-editing-instruction,`<editing-instruction>`>> <<element-editing-instruction,Editing Instruction>>, zero or more <<element-label,`<label>`>> <<element-label,Label of a Figure, Reference, Etc.>>, zero or one <<element-title,`<title>`>> <<element-title,Title>>, zero or one <<element-term-head,`<term-head>`>> <<element-term-head,Definition List: Term Head>>, zero or one <<element-def-head,`<def-head>`>> <<element-def-head,Definition List: Definition Head>>, zero or one <<element-def-item,`<def-item>`>> <<element-def-item,Definition List: Definition Item>>, zero or more <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>> <<element-def-list,Definition List>>, zero or more

#### In Glossary

[source,xml]
....
...
<sec sec-type="definitions">
 <label>1.10</label>
 <title>Glossary</title>
 <glossary>
  <def-list>
   <def-item>
    <term>bend qualification procedure</term>
    <def><p>a document that specifies the
     properties of the starting pipe; the equipment to be used;
     the bending parameters; the qualification bend test
     results; and the postbend, heat-treat equipment and
     cycle used for the manufacture of the bends. If nondestructive
     testing of the bend is required, procedures that
     have not been approved previously shall be submitted.</p></def>
   </def-item>
   <def-item>
    <term>cylinder</term>
    <def><p>a joint of pipe produced by a rolling andwelding
     plate, as opposed to a joint of pipe produced in accordance
     with a recognized specification.</p></def>
   </def-item>
   <def-item>
    <term>extrados</term>
    <def><p>the outside arc of the bend.</p></def>
   </def-item>
   ...
  </def-list>
 </glossary>
</sec>
...
....
